a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan only works if no storm hits for two rounds, about a 4% chance. If you want to renegotiate, for example by deciding who takes the existing 4 cells, say so clearly and I'll consider it openly. Until we both agree to a change, I'm sticking to the plan and won't take early.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. I'll keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4.
Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8 (barring a leak). Then I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
